description: This is a PHP source file that generates an HTML page for passenger information input in a bus booking web application. It manages session variables, displays session data, and includes client-side JavaScript for dynamic form handling.

methods.name: addrw
methods.description: Adds rows to the passenger info table dynamically based on user input.

methods.name: delrw
methods.description: Deletes a row from the passenger info table based on user input.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the age inputs are numeric before form submission.
